title: In Mooney’s en ville and in Mooney’s sur mer.
html_source: Mooney’s en ville and in Mooney’s sur mer: French for Mooney’s-in-town and in Mooney’s-on-the-sea Lenehan is referring to two pubs in the city centre, The latter is situated on one of the River Liffey’s quays, so Lenehan calls it sur mer, the other is in the city.
